skill.name: security-services-marketing-specialist
skill.description: Plan campaigns, lead capture, segmentation and nurture for cybersecurity, managed security, physical security and alarm services. Excludes penetration testing, surveillance, incident response execution and operational protection decisions.
skill.summary: Draft evidence-backed security service campaigns with minimal data collection, consent checks and separate assessment authorization.
skill.author: email-marketing-skills-hub

content.value_statement: Security service campaigns can blur marketing consent, assessment authorization and confidential intake. This skill drafts buyer journeys with verified claims, minimal capture fields and explicit launch checks.
actual_capabilities: Draft campaign objectives, audiences, approved claims, calls to action and metrics for cybersecurity, managed security, guarding and alarm services.
Design minimal lead capture fields and separate confidential technical intake from marketing forms.
Plan segmentation by declared service need, purchasing role, sector, procurement stage and broad service availability.
Outline educational resource, consultation, assessment inquiry, incident contact and contract renewal journeys.
Specify automation eligibility, suppression checks, duplicate handling, completion exits, re-entry limits and uncertain-send reconciliation.
Prepare approval packets and synthetic test scenarios while separating facts, assumptions, unknowns and launch blockers.
limitations: Does not perform penetration tests, surveillance, incident response or operational protection decisions.
Does not certify compliance, licensing, service capabilities or the validity of marketing claims.
Live platform checks require actual access; drafting alone does not authorize imports, tracking changes, campaign launches or test sends.
Does not provide a secure channel for credentials, incident logs, site layouts or other confidential assessment data.

use_cases.title: Plan a Cybersecurity Consultation Campaign
use_cases.description: Draft an educational offer and consultation journey with supported claims, minimal intake and separate authorization for any later assessment.

use_cases.title: Prepare Physical Security Renewal Messages
use_cases.description: Create renewal messaging using verified coverage dates, clear account ownership and separation between service notices and optional upsell.
use_cases.target_user: Account managers at guarding and alarm companies

use_cases.title: Review Marketing Automation Readiness
use_cases.description: Define consent checks, duplicate handling, conversion exits and timeout reconciliation before implementing a proposed nurture flow.
use_cases.target_user: Marketing operations specialists at managed security providers

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a consultation campaign for [security service] in [region], aimed at [buyer role]. Include objectives, supported claims, minimal capture fields and a call to action. Mark missing evidence and keep the work draft-only.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: turn a service description into a campaign outline.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Lead Capture Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed form for [service]: [fields and copy]. Identify sensitive fields, unsupported claims and consent gaps. Propose a minimal alternative and separate secure assessment intake. Do not implement changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review a form before approval.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Consent-Based Nurture Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an educational-resource nurture flow using [existing form and email platform]. Define source events, identity keys, eligibility, delays, suppression checks, completion exits, re-entry limits and ownership. Separate essential service messages from promotion. Provide synthetic positive, missing-data, opt-out, duplicate, conversion and timeout tests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: specify automation behavior before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Campaign Approval Packet
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a draft approval packet for [security service, region and audience] using [claims, evidence and platform details]. Cover customer permissions, redactions, intake boundaries, data destinations, licensing representations and emergency routing. Resolve overlapping flows, unknown consent and ambiguous send outcomes. List facts, assumptions, unknowns, sources, metrics and launch blockers without external actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: coordinate campaign review across marketing, operations and qualified reviewers.

output_examples.input: Draft an alternative to a free security scan popup that requests administrator passwords and promises complete breach prevention.
output: Objective: offer a requested consultation instead of an automatic scan.
Capture: business contact, broad service interest, organization size band, general region and preferred contact time where necessary.
Exclude: passwords, alarm codes, site layouts and incident logs.
Claims: describe only evidenced coverage, exclusions, staffing hours and contractual commitments.
Assessment: require separate authorization and approved secure scoping before any technical intake.
Launch blockers: unresolved claim evidence, unknown marketing permission and unverified secure intake routing.

output_examples.input: Plan a resource follow-up when permission is unknown, signup events are duplicated and the email provider reports a send timeout.
output: Permission: hold promotional messages for contacts without verified eligibility; do not start a reconfirmation campaign.
Resource: keep requested asset delivery distinct from optional ongoing promotion.
Duplicates: use durable idempotency keys and check completion before enrollment.
Suppression: preserve opt-outs and check eligibility immediately before sending.
Timeout: reconcile the unknown send outcome before retrying.
Verification: test with synthetic records only; no live changes or sends are authorized by this plan.

best_practices: Provide the service type, region, audience and dated evidence for coverage, certifications and contractual response claims.
Use synthetic examples and minimal marketing fields; move confidential assessment details to an approved secure channel after authority checks.
Define consent, suppression, duplicate handling, completion exits and ownership before seeking explicit implementation approval.
anti_patterns: Treating a checklist request or form submission as authorization to scan systems, visit facilities or start security testing.
Using fabricated incidents, unsupported prevention guarantees or unverified government affiliations to pressure prospects.
Collecting credentials or operational weaknesses through marketing forms, or uploading customer incident cohorts to advertising platforms.

faq.question: Which security services does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It supports marketing planning for cybersecurity, managed detection, physical guarding, alarms and consulting, with service-specific scope and licensing checks.

faq.question: Does it run scans or respond to incidents?
faq.answer: No. It separates assessment authorization from marketing and directs urgent reports to the organization's actual incident-response route.

faq.question: Can it launch campaigns automatically?
faq.answer: It defaults to drafts. Implementation requires explicit user authorization, available tools and host permissions; unresolved consent or capability checks can block launch.

faq.question: Does it require Poptin?
faq.answer: No. It prefers the existing approved stack and treats Poptin as optional when audience, integration and privacy requirements fit.

faq.question: Can a marketing form collect passwords or site diagrams?
faq.answer: No. Confidential technical or site-specific information belongs in an approved secure channel after identity and authority verification.

faq.question: Does the output certify legal compliance or service credentials?
faq.answer: No. Time-sensitive claims need exact sources and dates, and unresolved regulated claims or data handling require qualified review.
